C-23.Name: Release 2.3.0 without beta: ship the accumulated fixes, new icon and localized storefront
C-23.Summary: Cut the first non-beta release from main (56 commits since v2.2.0-beta as of 2026-10-15): C-24, C-29, C-30/31, C-32, C-33 icon, the i18n bundling fix, the context-menu click race, the M-031 diff fix and its review follow-up, the selection paint fix, C-38 N1 (macOS: no titlebar gear, Mark › Settings…). C-34 R2.1 (resilient Mermaid rendering) ships only if it is merged and smoke-checked before the tag. Upload the 10-locale App Store screenshots and listing texts prepared on 2026-10-14 together with the build.

Problem.Description: Users run v2.2.0-beta: non-English UI never loads, context-menu items are lost on the first click, Diff Mode shows no diff, and the store shows a circle icon, bare screenshots and one listing locale.

Goals.R-1: Version bump in all six synchronized places + release-preflight fixture (AGENTS.md Release steps); beta suffix dropped; PRERELEASE semantics unchanged.
Goals.R-2: Release notes «Что нового» grouped by area, user-facing wording; derived from the shipped C-* specs.
Goals.R-3: App Store Connect: new build, 10-locale screenshots and listing (name, subtitle, promo, keywords, description) from ~/Downloads/Mark-AppStore-2.3.0; Homebrew cask + winget follow the release workflow.
Goals.R-4: C-33 closed (icon approved by the user) before the tag.
Goals.R-5: MAS .pkg validated with Transporter / altool before submission (Assets.car icon, CFBundleIconName).

R1.1.Title: Approve C-33 icon; archive C-24-era leftovers

R1.2.Title: Version bump, preflight, tag (explicit user command only)

R1.3.Title: Store submission with localized assets; release notes

OpenQuestions.Q-1: Include C-34 R2.1 in 2.3.0, or freeze the scope at the current main and ship R2.1 in 2.3.1?
OpenQuestions.Q-2: Store screenshots show the titlebar gear on macOS (taken before C-38 N1): retake frames f1/f2/f6, or accept the mismatch for 2.3.0?
OpenQuestions.Q-3: ja/ko/zh listing texts still need a native proofread before submission — who proofreads, or ship them with the machine-reviewed text?

ReleaseSmoke.Check: Fresh install of the tagged build on macOS: Russian UI loads, ⌘, opens Settings, no titlebar gear, context menu works on the first click, Diff Mode shows a diff and exits with ⌘D, new icon in Dock/Finder in light/dark/tinted.
Windows lane: gear present in the frameless titlebar, settings open.
Updater: an installed 2.2.0-beta sees 2.3.0 through latest.json.

Constraints.Constraint: No tag or release without an explicit user command; six synchronized version places + preflight fixture.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: latest.json serves 2.3.0; App Store build approved with 10 listing locales; CI green on the tag.

AffectedAreas.Bundle: version files, release notes, App Store assets

C-23.VerificationIntent: release:preflight, CI on tag, latest.json check, App Store review result.
